summary: SCAQMD Rule 201 is the controlling permit-to-construct rule identified for this hypothesis. It requires written authorization before building, installing, altering, or replacing equipment whose use may cause air-contaminant emissions. The proposed coating/paint operation (coating booth) and solvent use/storage at a coating shop may emit VOC/air contaminants, so the Rule 201 trigger is met unless a separate exemption/registration pathway applies. Because the facility county/location is unresolved, this conclusion is conditional on the site being within South Coast AQMD jurisdiction; the local air district must be confirmed before final applicability.
title: H-AIR-201 — Permit to construct likely required for coating booth/solvent-emitting operation if in South Coast AQMD
